Renderer: per-Surface frame production (src/renderer/generic.zig)
|
|-- GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI): Metal or OpenGL at compile time
|   |-- terminal_state: terminal.RenderState (render cache, not emulator)
|   |-- font_shaper + GPU cell/image resources
|   |-- font_grid -> App.font_grid_set shared entry
|   `-- graphics resources -> borrowed App.device; target rt_surface
|-- updateFrame(), scheduled by Surface.renderer_thread
|   |-- Surface.renderer_state.lockDemand()
|   |-- terminal_state.beginUpdate(io.terminal): viewport / dirty state
|   |-- preedit / mouse snapshot; selection / cursor / Kitty image inputs
|   |-- unlockDemand(); terminal_state.endUpdate() outside shared lock
|   `-- RenderState + font grid + shaper -> glyphs / atlas-backed cells
|-- drawFrame() -> graphics API -> host surface presentation
|   `-- also called by Surface.draw() on main thread during resize
`-- Surface.renderer_thread (sibling manager, not owned by renderer)
    |-- wakeup / mailbox / timers -> frame scheduling
    `-- .resize -> renderer display geometry
